snippet.title: Yeeps 2.0 | NEW OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
We made a brand new trailer featuring our Star Creators to celebrate how far Yeeps has come! With 8+ game modes, 100+ gadgets (and even more blocks), thousands of Community Worlds, and so much more, we're so proud of this game, this community, and everything we've made together.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/yeeps
Play Yeeps for FREE: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/7276525889052788/

---

Unleash your imagination in Yeeps, the ultimate VR sandbox where creativity meets chaotic multiplayer action! Build epic bases, unlock powerful gadgets, brave treacherous dungeons, and master classic games like Hide & Seek, Prop Hunt, PvP Arena, and more! In this ever-changing open world, hilarious mayhem is inevitable and anything is possible.

Build Anything
Building is playing in Yeeps! Team up with friends, parkour around your evolving creations, and bring your wild ideas to life. Build tactically to survive or dive into Creative Mode and create entire worlds from the ground up.

100+ Gadgets to Unlock
Wield grappling hooks, sticky bombs, guitars, guided missiles, umbrellas, and so much more. Share items freely, try out hilarious strategies, and master tools that change how you build, fight, and explore!

Explore a Massive World
Gear up and raid dungeons for ancient loot. Swing through the city like a superhero. Or kick back at the beach and watch the sunset. There’s always something exciting to do and secrets to discover!

8+ Game Modes
Master Hide & Seek, outsmart foes in Prop Hunt, dominate PvP arenas, strategize in team battles, and more. With tons of game modes to find throughout the world, there are limitless ways to test your skills!

Endless Worlds to Discover
Discover a universe of player-created content! Build maps, publish them for glory, and explore new featured worlds daily!
